components.name: Admin navigation
components.description: Existing shell navigation with a quiet selected fill; desktop collapse leaves a 52px expand-control rail and persists across visits. Mobile retains its drawer.
components.css: .ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:34px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;padding:0 9px;font-family:var(--font-sans,sans-serif);font-size:var(--type-small,.84rem);font-weight:540;color:var(--admin-sidebar-text,#242724);text-decoration:none;transition:background-color var(--motion-fast,160ms) ease}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--admin-sidebar-hover,#e5e6e2)}.ds-nav .ds-active{background:var(--admin-sidebar-active,#dcded9);font-weight:620}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-brand,#116466);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Visual item accordion
components.description: Native disclosure per visual item, with image first. Header slides group image, title, caption, and button; Add header appends within the fixed section.
components.css: .ds-group{font-family:var(--font-sans,sans-serif);font-size:14px;min-width:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border,#ddd);color:#222}.ds-group>summary{cursor:pointer;padding:16px 4px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-group>summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-brand,#116466)}.ds-group-fields{display:grid;gap:14px;padding:0 4px 20px}.ds-group label{display:grid;gap:6px}.ds-group input,.ds-group select{font:inherit;width:100%;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;background:#fff;color:#222}.ds-group input:focus-visible,.ds-group select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #116466;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Image picker trigger
components.description: The image or empty placeholder opens the media picker. Hover and keyboard focus reveal the hint; touch and empty states keep it visible.

narrative.overview: The established direction is quiet administrative chrome around the actual client website. This document records the Content editor inside Showrunner's existing admin shell; it does not prescribe a visual identity for client websites or unrelated Showrunner surfaces. The explicit composition in PRODUCT.md is the direction contract.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained white surfaces, fine dividers, compact controls.
A central website preview with a contextual right inspector.
Client typography, imagery, colors, and responsive behavior remain owned by the website.
dos: Do preserve the existing Showrunner shell and tenant brand tokens.
Do keep the real website central and the inspector contextual.
Do retain keyboard access, visible focus, field labels, and publish feedback.
donts: Don't substitute reconstructed editor cards for the real website iframe.
Don't apply admin typography or colors to the client website.
Don't expose controls that add, remove, duplicate, or reorder page sections.
